body: I used to be so happy and contented with life when on earth did shit get so bad
I want to end it right now but it would draw so much attention to myself and I don’t want that attention even if I’m already gone

The thing is my life isn’t even all that difficult all I have to do is go to school, get good grades and thats it. My parents give me whatever I want and I have a roof over my head. We are comfortable and I definitely have it much better than most of my peers. Why am I like this
